detail.title: Riser 30 Aluminium Tilt-Adjustable Laptop Stand - Carbon Black
detail.overview: The Ant Riser 30 is an aluminium laptop stand designed for devices from 10 to 17 inches, with a tilt-adjustable angle that helps reduce neck fatigue, back strain and eye strain during long work sessions. Its sturdy metal build supports the weight of larger laptops without wobbling, while anti-skid silicone pads on both the top and bottom secure the device in place and protect it from scratches or sliding. An open, ventilated top design improves airflow beneath the laptop for better heat dissipation, and the foldable, portable shape makes it easy to pack away or carry between home, office and outdoor workspaces, finished here in a sleek Carbon Black tone.
